verdict.rationale: Oneleet's frameworks page lists ISO 27001 as a supported framework [oneleet-docs-29]. The compliance docs show that adding a framework automatically adds its controls [oneleet-docs-15], which suggests framework-level control handling. Nothing shows ISO 27001 is first-class rather than a simple listing or mapping. Missing for 10: evidence of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation or management, ISO certification-audit artifacts or auditor workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
